implementationChanges.summary: Scope legacy snapshot CSS to the old wrapper so current three-column review headings retain shared padding.
Remove the one proven positional last-button hide in CAP10; shared detail now decides the authorized actions.
CAP20 authorized rate catalog provides the select label while preserving exact selected value, unknown IDs and no-catalog fallback.
Assert all four CAP23 actions, narrow row height <=200px and capture real horizontal scrolling without clicking/mutating actions.

Preserve comparable identities in CAP19/20/21/25; distinguish duplicate rate/quote options; localize readable review values; precision-preserving number presentation; human EN/PT copy; narrow row inset; exact updated UI assertions.
Six readable English vendor contract option labels, with wire values unchanged.

Present canonical finite numeric amount strings without precision loss or payload changes; retain one original CAP19 POST response outside Chromium CDP body cache. Preserve unchanged native source checks.

confirmedFindings.result: All three source headers have equal inset and align with the values below; footer actions remain visible.

Previously opened full Core4 originals show Open page, Delete project and Edit project together and a legible named delete confirmation. Latest Core6 contact sheets reconfirm these states and the entire Portfolio native case passes. No producer admission changed.
Authorized rate name is used in the select; exact ID remains in Record reference. The original ID is asserted in the command/readback.
No large empty row before the name. All four actions appear in a compact 2×2 grid after real horizontal scroll; row <=200px test passed.

CAP20 rate names, CAP21 entity names, CAP25 selected supplier and CAP19 project names retain exact IDs inside comparable values. Full originals were opened for all four. Same-supplier/same-total A-to-B collision test passed in the 20/20 focal gate, preserving command/CAS/readback checks. Planning6 and Core6 pass.

The complete wave-two case passed with exact July plus source-year assertion and original OPEX write. English narrow review visibly reads July 2026; Portuguese review reads julho de 2026. No numeric-month or date assertion was weakened.
The original390px captures show visible12px inline inset between the shaded row and its text. Records and Portuguese editor/review journeys passed4/4.

Final Ops5, Planning6 and Core6 contact sheets and focused originals verify human EN/PT review text, known enum/boolean labels and retained source values. CAP25 shows 16,500 without invented currency, and 20,200 EUR / 21,100 USD with source identities. CAP14 shows 36,000, Annual and Fixed. Opaque producer comparison strings remain unchanged.

The full original displays Amount 36,000, Amount type Annual and Renewal Fixed. Presentation groups only finite canonical numeric strings with an exact Number round trip. Focused tests preserve the literal command scalar and keep precision-sensitive/noncanonical strings and NaN/Infinity literal. The native Finance case passes unchanged source/payload checks.

The native Finance case passes with qualified forwardOnce registered before Save project. It forwards exactly one original POST response unchanged, with redirects/retries disabled, and reads the APIResponse. HTTP/body/payload, exactly-one-POST and fresh source readback checks remain. The opened original shows the revised project after that save; spread review retains project name plus exact ID.
